product_one_liner.value: Spacelift is an infrastructure orchestration platform that automates infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and governance for DevOps, platform, and SRE teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes managing provisioning, configuration, and governance, and explicitly identifies DevOps, platform, and SRE teams as its users: https://spacelift.io/about-us.

pricing_page.notes: Spacelift has a public plans-and-pricing page: https://spacelift.io/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The customer-success page contains case studies explicitly naming Figma and 1Password as users: https://www.spacelift.io/customers. | named_customers.0: A customer case study describes Figma orchestrating infrastructure with Spacelift: https://www.spacelift.io/customers. | named_customers.1: A customer case study describes 1Password using Spacelift for IaC management: https://www.spacelift.io/customers.

employee_band.notes: The careers page reports more than 130 employees, while the company profile gives a 51–200 range; together they support the requested 101–200 band: https://careers.spacelift.io/ and https://linkedin.com/company/spacelift-io.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile explicitly lists headquarters as Redwood City, California: https://linkedin.com/company/spacelift-io. | hq_country: The company profile identifies headquarters as Redwood City, California, placing it in the United States: https://linkedin.com/company/spacelift-io.

founded_year.notes: The company explicitly states that it was founded in 2020: https://careers.spacelift.io/.

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying posts explain Spacelift's own implementation: Jacob Martin, a software engineering team lead, discusses database optimization (https://spacelift.io/blog/tricking-postgres-into-using-query-plan), and backend engineer Adam Connelly explains worker architecture (https://spacelift.io/blog/ci-cd-workers-in-kubernetes-dind).

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site contains multiple product articles and sections, including notifications and dashboard documentation: https://docs.spacelift.io/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable current jobs index lists eight openings, none with a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title: https://careers.spacelift.io/jobs.

model_provider.value: Anthropic Claude models via Amazon Bedrock.
model_provider.notes: The AI integrations documentation explicitly identifies the Spacelift-managed default integration as AWS Bedrock (Anthropic), with Claude models. This distinguishes the default from optional customer-supplied providers: https://docs.spacelift.io/concepts/intelligence/ai-integrations.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The trust center lists GDPR and provides a SOC 2 Type II report and a PCI-DSS SAQ-A document. These are public compliance claims; GDPR is a regulatory framework and the PCI document is a self-assessment, rather than separate certification awards: https://trust.spacelift.io/. | compliance_certs.0: The trust center provides a SOC 2 Type II report: https://trust.spacelift.io/. | compliance_certs.1: GDPR appears in the trust center's compliance section: https://trust.spacelift.io/. | compliance_certs.2: The trust center lists a PCI-DSS SAQ-A document: https://trust.spacelift.io/.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company calls the $51 million financing a Series C, matching the latest listed funding stage: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/spacelift-raises-51m-series-c-to-redefine-enterprise-infrastructure-automation-302501578.html. | funding_date: The company announced the Series C on July 10, 2025. Its latest-round funding record also places it in July 2025, so both support 2025-07 despite a one-day difference: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/spacelift-raises-51m-series-c-to-redefine-enterprise-infrastructure-automation-302501578.html. | funding_amount_usd: The company announced a $51 million Series C, corroborated as the latest listed round by its funding history. The amount uses the company's stated USD figure: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/spacelift-raises-51m-series-c-to-redefine-enterprise-infrastructure-automation-302501578.html.

raised_18mo.notes: The $51 million financing announced July 10, 2025 falls within the eighteen-month window: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/spacelift-raises-51m-series-c-to-redefine-enterprise-infrastructure-automation-302501578.html.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists an Enterprise Account Executive opening, and its live posting is readable: https://careers.spacelift.io/jobs/8625239-enterprise-account-executive-remote-us-texas.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 29, 2026 announcement launches Spacelift Flows, a new visual workflow-automation part of the platform, within six months: https://spacelift.io/blog/full-stack-infrastructure-orchestration.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On May 5, 2026, Spacelift announced John Henry Archer as senior vice president of sales and channel and Jonah Kowall as senior vice president of product and design, within the twelve-month window: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/spacelift-adds-senior-leaders-in-sales-and-product-as-growth-momentum-accelerates-with-spacelift-intelligence-302762880.html.
